blocks.html: The attributes in the region to be created or updated.

types.name: id
types.description: The id of the region in the case of an update

types.name: name
types.description:
The target name of the region. Required when
creating a region.

types.name: currency_code
types.description:
The currency code of the region. Required when
creating a region.

types.name: automatic_taxes
types.description: Setting to indicate whether taxes need to be applied automatically.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
